topics.title: Comments
topics.summary: Text after # is ignored by Python. Use it to leave notes for yourself.
topics.example_code:
# This line is a note
print("Notes are free")  # so is this part

topics.title: print()
topics.summary: print() shows text or values in the console. Text goes inside quotes. Several values can be separated with commas.

topics.title: Variables
topics.summary: A variable stores a value under a name. Use = to store it, then use the name later.

topics.title: Math operators
topics.summary: Use + - * / for arithmetic. // divides and drops the decimals, % gives the remainder, ** is a power.

topics.title: if and else
topics.summary: if runs code only when a condition is true. else runs when it is not. Indent the code inside by 4 spaces.

topics.title: for loops and range()
topics.summary: A for loop repeats code. range(3) gives 0, 1 and 2, so the loop body runs three times.
topics.example_code:
for i in range(3):
    print("Water plant", i + 1)
